test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a garrison town?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jalandhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A garrison **is any **body of troops **stationed in a **particular location**, originally to **guard it**.
 
• The **term **now **often applies **to certain **facilities **that **constitute **a **military base **or **fortified military headquarters.**
 
• A **garrison **is usually in a **city, town, fort, castle, ship, or similar site**.
 
• The **main function **of the **garrison towns **is **to cater to the **needs of **defence and people employed **in **defence services **of the **nation**.
 
• These are **specially designed **for the **purpose of military**, **navy **or **airforce activities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Two garrison **(cantonment) **towns of India**

 
 
• **​Ambala**: is also known for its large Indian Army and Indian Air Force presence within its cantonment area which was established in the year 1843
 
• **Jalandhar**.
